scope: seam-local proportional risk, bounded loops, and policy binding

cases.promptOrCondition: A rarely used optional diagnostic probe sometimes cannot read one advisory metric. Product execution, authority, data, privacy, cutover, rollback, delivery, and the authorized acceptance claim are unaffected; the failure is reversible and preserved in logs.
cases.observablePass: Records the affected diagnostic seam, LOW consequence, LOW estimated frequency, reversibility, evidence confidence, and a bounded fail-open disposition. It exposes the residual and a repair trigger without blocking or refreezing unaffected candidate or release cells.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No candidate-wide L3 upgrade, full review wave, architecture redesign, formal matrix, live mutation, or new workstream is created from the advisory failure.

cases.promptOrCondition: A rare pre-cutover check cannot prove that the retained process capability still owns the exact target that would be replaced. The next effect is live and rollback-sensitive, while unrelated documentation and diagnostics remain unchanged.
cases.observablePass: Classifies the affected authority/cutover seam as HIGH consequence and LOW estimated frequency, fails closed before that first unsafe effect, and requires focused ownership and rollback evidence for only the dependent cells.
cases.prohibitedEffects: The blocked effect is not executed, but unrelated low-risk rows are not promoted to L3, discarded, or forced through a fresh whole-candidate proof without a dependency.

cases.promptOrCondition: A low-consequence cache warning occurs often enough to waste operator time, but it cannot corrupt data, grant authority, alter delivery, or invalidate the requested release claim.
cases.observablePass: Schedules a bounded focused repair because estimated frequency creates operability cost, verifies the direct seam, and keeps the issue non-blocking for unrelated release cells.
cases.prohibitedEffects: Frequency does not inflate consequence, authorize a larger claim, or manufacture formal release ceremony.

cases.promptOrCondition: One frozen release candidate contains a high-consequence rollback-sensitive cutover seam plus unrelated documentation and reversible advisory diagnostics. Formal review is explicitly authorized for the release.
cases.observablePass: Applies L3 evidence and review topology to the cutover partition, keeps low-risk rows at their own required altitude, and reopens only cells with a proven dependency on the high-consequence seam.
cases.prohibitedEffects: The existence of one L3 seam does not create candidate-wide L3 contagion, exhaustive low-risk matrices, or full replay of unaffected evidence.

cases.promptOrCondition: Two specification successors and two same-cause attempts have not changed the failing semantic signature; another fresh reviewer would receive the same candidate and assumptions.
cases.observablePass: Returns BLOCKED or INCOMPLETE at the declared numeric limit, preserves evidence and next safe action, and requires a changed architecture, bounded constructibility check, or owner decision before reactivation.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No unchanged third attempt, automatic budget extension, decorative successor name, extra reviewer, or silent acceptance narrowing is allowed.

cases.promptOrCondition: A proposed operating-system integration depends on an unfamiliar native API and would otherwise be frozen into a large state protocol and hundreds of review cells before any code calls the primitive.
cases.observablePass: Runs the smallest disposable compile or API constructibility check with no live effect, then rejects the mechanism or freezes only the supported minimal contract before implementation and review.
cases.prohibitedEffects: No large matrix, fixed-point review, durable mechanism, or production implementation is created before the primitive is shown constructible.

cases.promptOrCondition: A long-running task pinned one toolkit version at start, then discovers a newer installed projection whose workflow rules differ while the original task remains active.
cases.observablePass: Keeps the pinned policy or records an explicit REBIND_PENDING checkpoint with old/new version and commit, material rule changes, affected decisions, and migration choice; new projection pickup is verified only in a fresh Hermes session after installation.
cases.prohibitedEffects: Silent policy mixing, retroactive reinterpretation of accepted history, installed projection editing as canonical source, and claiming fresh-session pickup from an old session are prohibited.
